title_vi: Tính từ + to-infinitive, -ing, mệnh đề that, mệnh đề wh-
theory_html:
A. Adjective + to-infinitive, -ing, that-clause, wh-clause

A. Tính từ + to-infinitive, -ing, mệnh đề that, mệnh đề wh-

When an adjective comes after a linking verb (e.g. appear, be, become, seem) we can use a number of patterns after the adjective including a to-infinitive, -ing, that-clause, and wh-clause:

Khi tính từ đứng sau động từ nối (vd. appear, be, become, seem), có thể dùng nhiều cấu trúc sau tính từ, gồm to-infinitive, -ing, mệnh đề that và mệnh đề wh-:

adjective +
tính từ +		example
ví dụ		adjectives used
tính từ dùng
(i) to-infinitiveYou’re free to leave at any time you want.(un)able, careful, crazy, curious, difficult, easy, foolish, free, good, hard, impossible, inclined, mad, nice, prepared, ready, stupid, welcome, willing
(ii) -ingHe was busy doing his homework.busy, crazy, foolish, mad, stupid; (after feel) awful, awkward, bad, good, guilty, terrible
(iii) that-clause
mệnh đề that		He became worried (that) she might fall down.afraid, alarmed, amazed, angry, annoyed, ashamed, astonished, aware, concerned, disappointed, glad, (un)happy, pleased, shocked, sorry, upset, worried; certain, confident, positive, sure
(iv) wh-clause
mệnh đề wh-		I’m not certain (of / about) why he wants to borrow the money.afraid, not aware / unaware, not certain / uncertain, doubtful, not sure / unsure, worried
(v) to-infinitive or that-clause
to-infinitive hoặc mệnh đề that		She was afraid to say anything. / I was afraid that I would be late.the adjectives in (iii), except aware, confident and positive
(vi) to-infinitive or -ing
to-infinitive hoặc -ing		He’d be stupid to leave now. / He’d be stupid giving up the job.crazy, foolish, mad, stupid
(vii) -ing or that-clause
-ing hoặc mệnh đề that		She felt awful leaving him with all the clearing up. / She felt awful that she was late.(after feel) awful, awkward, bad, good, guilty, terrible

B. It + linking verb + adjective

B. It + động từ nối + tính từ

We can sometimes use it + linking verb + adjective + to-infinitive as an alternative to subject + linking verb + adjective + to-infinitive:

Đôi khi có thể dùng it + động từ nối + tính từ + to-infinitive thay cho chủ ngữ + động từ nối + tính từ + to-infinitive:

  • The fireworks were amazing to watch. or It was amazing to watch the fireworks.

    Pháo hoa xem thật tuyệt. / Thật tuyệt khi được xem pháo hoa.

Also: annoying, awkward, easy, good, interesting, lovely, simple, terrific, wonderful.

Tương tự: annoying, awkward, easy, good, interesting, lovely, simple, terrific, wonderful.

In informal speech we can use an -ing form instead of a to-infinitive:

Trong văn nói thân mật, có thể dùng -ing thay cho to-infinitive:

  • It is easy understanding her. / It was amazing watching the fireworks.

    Hiểu cô ấy thật dễ. / Xem pháo hoa thật tuyệt.

We can use a similar pattern with adjective + wh- or that-clause:

Có thể dùng cấu trúc tương tự với tính từ + mệnh đề wh- hoặc that:

  • It is not clear why he did it.

    Không rõ tại sao anh ta làm vậy.

  • It was odd that she left so suddenly.

    Thật lạ là cô ấy bỏ đi đột ngột như vậy.

After certain adjectives we often include of + subject between the adjective and a to-infinitive:

Sau một số tính từ, ta thường thêm of + chủ ngữ giữa tính từ và to-infinitive:

  • It was rude (of them) to criticise her. or They were rude to criticise her.

    Họ thật thô lỗ khi chỉ trích cô ấy.

Also: brave, generous, kind, mean, thoughtful, unprofessional, unreasonable.

Tương tự: brave, generous, kind, mean, thoughtful, unprofessional, unreasonable.

When we talk about how somebody reacts to a situation we can use it + make with an adjective and to-infinitive, -ing or that-clause:

Khi nói ai đó phản ứng với tình huống thế nào, có thể dùng it + make + tính từ + to-infinitive, -ing hoặc mệnh đề that:

  • It made me angry (to discover) that so much money was wasted. (or It made me angry discovering that … or I was angry to discover that …)

    Tôi tức giận khi phát hiện ra quá nhiều tiền bị lãng phí.

Also: ashamed, furious, glad, happy, miserable, nervous, sad, tired, uncomfortable.

Tương tự: ashamed, furious, glad, happy, miserable, nervous, sad, tired, uncomfortable.

mcq.question: You’re free ___ at any time you want.
mcq.full: You’re free to leave at any time you want.
mcq.vi: Bạn cứ tự nhiên ra về bất cứ lúc nào.
mcq.expl:
Adjective + to-infinitive (free to leave), -ing (busy doing), that-clause (worried that), wh-clause (not certain why); afraid / sorry etc. + to-inf or that; crazy / stupid etc. + to-inf or -ing; feel awful / guilty etc. + -ing or that.
Tính từ + to-infinitive (free to leave), -ing (busy doing), mệnh đề that (worried that), mệnh đề wh- (not certain why); afraid / sorry v.v. + to-inf hoặc that; crazy / stupid v.v. + to-inf hoặc -ing; feel awful / guilty v.v. + -ing hoặc that.
Điểm ngữ pháp: free + to-infinitive.
mcq.key: You’re free ___ at any time you want.|to leave
